description: Presidential Secretariat - Duties & Functions for the Ministers, amending Gaz. Ex. Nos. 2103/33 and 2103/34
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific personnel information (President Maithripala Sirisena is named as the authority making these changes) and detailed portfolio responsibilities (it amends the assignment of functions, duties, departments, and laws to specific ministerial positions such as "Minister of Finance" and "Minister of Public Enterprise, Kandyan Heritage and Kandy Development"). The content includes both the "who" (the President) and the "what" (detailed changes to ministerial responsibilities and the specific laws/institutions under their purview), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
